items.name: Crossbow
items.description: This ranged weapon has a bow-like assembly mounted on a handled frame called a tiller. The tiller has a mechanism to lock the bowstring in place, attached to a trigger mechanism that releases the tension and launches a bolt.

items.name: Greatclub
items.description: While many greatclubs are intricately carved, others are little more than a sturdy tree branch. These massive clubs are too heavy to wield with only one hand.

items.name: Splint Mail
items.description: This type of armor is chain mail reinforced with flexible, interlocking metal plates, typically located on the wearer's torso, upper arms, and legs. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Padded Armor] and a pair of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Gauntlet]{gauntlets}.

defensiveAbilities.name: Destructive Vengeance
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The champion of Zagresh is injured by an enemy within 15 feet

Effect The champion of Zagresh increases the amount of damage he takes by 2d6 Untyped Damage and deals 2d6 Void Damage damage to the triggering enemy. In addition, the champion deals 2 extra void damage with their Strikes against the triggering creature until the end of his next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fit of Rage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The champion swings his greatclub in a wide circle, making a melee Strike against all creatures within reach. On a critical hit, enemies are moved back 5 feet. This is forced movement. Each Strike counts toward the champion's multiple attack penalty, but his penalty doesn't increase until he's made all of his attacks.

offensiveAbilities.name: Intimidating Strike
offensiveAbilities.description: The champion of Zagresh makes a melee Strike. If they hit and deal damage, the target is Frightened 1, or Frightened 2 on a critical hit.

lv1spells.name: Touch of the Void
lv1spells.targets: 1 willing undead creature or 1 living creature
lv1spells.description:
You infuse the target with void energy, healing undead or damaging a living creature.

  • Willing Undead Creature The target regains 6 Hit Points. If the target is yourself, you also gain a +2 status bonus to damage rolls for 1 round.

  • Living Creature The target takes 1d6 void damage with a basic Fortitude save; on a failure, the target also takes a –2 status penalty to AC for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 6, and the damage to a living target increases by 1d6.
